metadata.title: Modern Country Album Cover with Backlit Portrait

retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a man in western attire framed by dark vertical elements and intense white backlighting with horizontal lens flares.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man wearing a cowboy hat and plaid shirt, positioned in a bright doorway that creates a silhouette effect on the outer edges while flooding the center with warm, hazy light and horizontal flares.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between two dark vertical framing elements
Intense white backlighting creating a halo effect around the head and shoulders
Horizontal light flares intersecting the subject's chest and the typography
Text layered over the subject's torso with semi-transparent blending
coreInvariants: High-contrast backlighting that washes out the background into pure white
Warm color temperature with golden and amber highlights
Symmetrical framing using vertical architectural elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat, emphasized by the brightest point of light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright center outward to the dark framing edges, then down to the large-scale typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space on the left and right vertical margins; blown-out white negative space behind the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm white and golden light (background and flares)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and black (framing doors and hat)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue and purple tones (plaid shirt pattern)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center, low value on the edges; saturation is muted by the hazy light overlay.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens as primary tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Wide, geometric sans-serif and expressive script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, squared-off strokes with open counters
Secondary text uses a fluid, handwritten script with varying line weights
Integration of geometric diamond shapes within specific letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-shaped characters replaced or augmented with diamond-within-square motifs
Horizontal bars in letters like 'H' and 'N' are perfectly aligned
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, architectural sans-serif and organic, flowing script.

preserve: Geometric squareness of the main title
The angled baseline of the script text
avoid: Standard vertical orientation for the script

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, squared-off geometric foundation for the display text.
Matches the informal, handwritten energy of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a cowboy hat and plaid shirt standing in a bright doorway. Use heavy backlighting to create a white glow behind him and dark vertical shadows on the left and right edges. Include warm horizontal lens flares across the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, wide geometric sans-serif text in the center, using a gold-to-white gradient. Below it, add a handwritten script at a slight upward angle. Ensure the text has a soft glow and interacts with the lens flares.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered between two dark vertical pillars?
Is the background blown out to pure white?
Does the primary text have a wide, squared-off appearance?
Are there horizontal light streaks crossing the image?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Thin, delicate fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the backlighting doesn't obscure the subject's face entirely.
Ensure the horizontal flares don't make the text unreadable.
Verify the contrast between the dark edges and the bright center.
Confirm the script text is angled correctly relative to the main title.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered subject + vertical framing + high-key backlighting + wide geometric display type + angled script subtitle.
